rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for any person to sell, license, or provide an algorithmic device to a landlord, and it is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental properties in the City of San Diego.

rules.exemptions: Does not include software used to publish reports from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data older than 90 days or public information without recommending future rates/occupancy, software used to establish rates/income limits per affordable housing guidelines, or appraisal software that does not recommend rental rates during runtime operation.
rules.citation: San Diego Municipal Code ch. 9, art. 8, div. 11
rules.quoted_span: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord. It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
